title: onobrychis supina
intro: Onobrychis supina, commonly known as Siberian bird's foot trefoil, is a perennial plant species in the pea family that is native to Asia and Europe. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Onobrychis supina include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The plant's bioactive constituents have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various health conditions.
